name: Joiner
description: Joins two tables on key columns using an inner, left, right, full, semi or anti join, as an asof join on a time column, or as a cross join. Semi and anti joins keep only the left columns. Key columns can be merged into one output column. An asof join matches every left row with the nearest right row whose time is before (asof_inequality >=) or after (<=) its own time, optionally restricted by equality keys. A cross join returns every combination and uses no keys. A right-side column whose name already appears in the output is renamed with the suffix " (Right)".

how.title: Join type
how.description: Join mode between the left and right inputs; semi and anti keep the left rows that do (semi) or do not (anti) have a match, and return only the left columns.

left_keys.title: Left keys
left_keys.description: Key columns from the left input.

right_keys.title: Right keys
right_keys.description: Key columns from the right input, matched positionally with the left keys.

merge_keys.title: Merge keys
merge_keys.description: Merge the key columns into one output column.

left_time.title: Left time column
left_time.description: Time column of the left input for an asof join.

right_time.title: Right time column
right_time.description: Time column of the right input for an asof join.

asof_inequality.title: Asof inequality
asof_inequality.description: >= matches the nearest previous right row, <= the nearest following one.
